tbesh_subentries.definition_html:
1) howdah, palanquin, basket saddle
1a) an enclosed riding space erected on a camel's saddle

strongs_1890.strongs_def: a ram (as full-grown and fat), including a battering-ram (as butting); hence, a meadow (as for sheep); also a pad or camel's saddle (as puffed out)
strongs_1890.derivation: from H3769 (כָּרַר) in the sense of plumpness;
strongs_1890.kjv_def: captain, furniture, lamb, (large) pasture, ram. See also H1033 (בֵּית כַּר), H3746 (כָּרִי).
